name: Heterogeneous In-scattering with Multiple Scattering
definition: Computes the radiance contribution from light scattering within a heterogeneous volume. It handles direct lighting from light sources and recursively computes indirect lighting (multiple scattering) up to a maximum depth.
summary: Heterogeneous In-scattering with Multiple Scattering computes volumetric radiance by evaluating local extinction and scattering coefficients at each step to capture spatially varying density and recursive indirect lighting.
